78fe98dfbcd1.name: Frag Assault Launchers
78fe98dfbcd1.plain: Whenever this model completes a charge move within 1" of an enemy unit, roll one D6. On a 4+, the enemy unit suffers D3 mortal wounds.

7953863ef01c.name: Iconarch (Aura)
7953863ef01c.plain: Aura: while one of your <LEGION> CULTISTS units is within 6" of this unit's ICONARCH model, models in that unit add 2 to their Leadership, and you re-roll hit rolls of 1 for their attacks.

79d271292956.name: Warp-born Foresight
79d271292956.plain: At the end of the Reinforcements step in your opponent's Movement phase: pick one of your TRAITORIS ASTARTES TZEENTCH units that is not within Engagement Range of any enemy units, then pick one enemy unit within 12" of it that was set up as Reinforcements this turn. That TZEENTCH unit may shoot as though it were your Shooting phase; if it does, its models can target only that enemy unit (and only if it is an eligible target).

7a054a89b72b.name: Melta array
7a054a89b72b.plain: Whenever the bearer fights, it gets 1 extra attack with this weapon, and it can't make more than one attack with this weapon.

7a152fcb1ace.name: Terrifying Phenomena
7a152fcb1ace.plain: At the start of the Morale phase: pick one enemy unit within 12" of one of your TRAITORIS ASTARTES CHAOS UNDIVIDED units. For the rest of the phase: your opponent can't pick that unit for the Insane Bravery Stratagem, and can't use any rule that lets them re-roll a Morale test for it; and any action that unit is performing fails immediately if it fails a Morale test.

7ac8fa557646.name: Souls of the Devoted
7ac8fa557646.plain: At the start of your Movement phase: pick one of your DAEMONKIN RITUALISTS POSSESSED units and one friendly DAEMONKIN RITUALISTS CHARACTER within 6" of it, and roll a D3. The POSSESSED unit suffers that many mortal wounds, and then the CHARACTER regains that many lost wounds.

7c561455c11e.name: Let the Galaxy Burn
7c561455c11e.plain:
This unit gets the rules below if every unit in your army has the TRAITORIS ASTARTES keyword (ignoring any AGENT OF CHAOS or UNALIGNED models) and all <LEGION> units in your army (other than ABADDON THE DESPOILER) come from the same Legion:
- Whenever a model in this unit fires a flame weapon, add 2 to the number of attacks that weapon makes this phase (for example, a flamer makes D6+2 attacks).
- This unit gets a bonus (described below) based on which wanton act it is engaged in:
- Battle round 1: your army and all of its units are engaged in Wanton Destruction.
- Battle round 2: your whole army, including each of its units, is engaged in Wanton Massacre.
- Battle round 3: when it starts, choose Wanton Massacre or Wanton Slaughter; until that battle round ends, your army and each unit in it is engaged in the act you chose.
- Battle round 4 and every later battle round: your army and all of its units are engaged in Wanton Slaughter.

7c5f47a6674b.name: Faithful Flock
7c5f47a6674b.plain: While this unit includes a CULT DEMAGOGUE model, it automatically passes every Morale test it takes.

7ca0c7cff80a.name: Sabotaged Armoury
7ca0c7cff80a.plain: In any phase, when an enemy VEHICLE model is destroyed: if any of your ALPHA LEGION units are on the battlefield, that model explodes automatically instead of your opponent rolling to see whether it explodes. If a rule says that model never explodes, ignore both that rule and this Stratagem, and roll for the explosion as normal. Cost: 1 CP if the model has a Wounds characteristic of 9 or less, 2 CP if its Wounds characteristic is 10 to 19, and 3 CP otherwise.

7ce4dc9e17bf.name: Thunderhawk cluster bombs
7ce4dc9e17bf.plain: Once per battle, after the bearer has moved, you can pick one unit it moved across. Roll six D6 for each VEHICLE or MONSTER model in that unit and one D6 for each other model in it (up to a maximum of 18); for every 4+, that unit suffers 1 mortal wound. As updated in January 2023, this ability only works if the bearer is still on the battlefield when its move has finished.

7fb5a0c5e550.name: Sickly Resistance
7fb5a0c5e550.plain: Roll one D6 each time this model would lose a wound: on a 5+, the wound is ignored.

7fe8957e40dc.name: Helbrute plasma cannon
7fe8957e40dc.plain: Blast. For every attack with this weapon that gets an unmodified hit roll of 1, the bearer suffers 1 mortal wound once it has finished shooting with this weapon.

810b1ce63088.name: The Chirurgeon
810b1ce63088.plain: If FABIUS BILE is about to lose a wound, roll a D6; on a 5+ he keeps that wound. When your Command phase starts, he gets back up to D3 lost wounds.

8164035dd3eb.name: Escape
8164035dd3eb.plain: Once per battle, when any Shooting phase or Fight phase ends, you may lift this model off the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves. It is destroyed if it is not on the battlefield at the end of the battle.

819d096c3863.name: Plague belcher
819d096c3863.plain: Attacks with this weapon hit their target automatically, and wound rolls of 1 for it can be re-rolled.

81e7d8ed2e37.name: Plasma pistol, Supercharge
81e7d8ed2e37.plain: If any attack with this weapon profile gets an unmodified hit roll of 1, the bearer is destroyed once it has finished shooting this weapon.

829e2c6492cb.name: Mutant claw
829e2c6492cb.plain: Whenever the bearer fights, it gets 1 extra attack with this weapon, and it can't make more than one attack with this weapon in that fight.

84137093d853.name: Agent of Discord
84137093d853.plain: Each time your opponent uses a rule that would let them gain Command points or get Command points refunded (not counting the Battleforged CP bonus), roll one D6: on a 4+, they don't gain or get back those Command points.

8441dc574613.name: Flay Them Alive
8441dc574613.plain: In the Fight phase, when one of your NIGHT LORDS HERETIC ASTARTES models destroys the enemy WARLORD with a melee attack. For the rest of the battle, subtract 1 from every Combat Attrition test taken for an enemy unit.

84422a1f8d53.name: Graviton blaster
84422a1f8d53.plain: Attacks from this weapon have Damage 2 when allocated to a model whose Save characteristic is 3+ or better.

848be7cdbac7.name: Forward, for the Dark Gods!
848be7cdbac7.plain: Once per turn, this unit can use this ability when one of your TRAITOR GUARDSMEN SQUAD units fails a Morale test while it is within 6" of this unit's TRAITOR ENFORCER model. If it does, until the end of the phase, that TRAITOR GUARDSMEN SQUAD unit automatically passes any Combat Attrition tests it takes.

850645c10a37.name: Explodes
850645c10a37.plain: If this model is destroyed, roll a D6 before taking it off the battlefield. On a 6, it explodes and every unit within 6" takes D3 mortal wounds.

85bb8bf8f79f.name: Possession
85bb8bf8f79f.plain: Witchfire: if this power is manifested, pick one enemy unit within 9" of this PSYKER that it can see. Roll one D6, adding 1 if the Psychic test was an unmodified 10+. If the total is higher than that unit's Toughness, your opponent picks one model in that unit and it is destroyed. Then, if the unit has not been destroyed, it suffers D3 mortal wounds.

85ff2b78f878.name: Master of Possession
85ff2b78f878.plain: Knows Smite plus two psychic powers from the Malefic discipline.

86d94b4e7e72.name: In Midnight Clad
86d94b4e7e72.plain: In your opponent's Shooting phase, when a NIGHT LORDS INFANTRY unit (not a CULTISTS unit) is chosen as the target of a ranged attack. For the rest of the phase, subtract 1 from the hit roll of every ranged attack made against that unit.

87d65df190bc.name: Blazing Weapons
87d65df190bc.plain: This model can still shoot in a turn in which it Advanced or Fell Back.

87e445b2e72c.name: Hellstrike missile battery
87e445b2e72c.plain: Add 1 to the hit roll of attacks this weapon makes against an AIRCRAFT unit, and its attacks that are allocated to an AIRCRAFT unit have Damage D3+3.

883d5a02c707.name: Hellforged heavy plasma cannon - Supercharge
883d5a02c707.plain: Blast. For every attack with this profile that gets an unmodified hit roll of 1, the bearer suffers 1 mortal wound once it has finished shooting with this weapon.

88c671a2e1a1.name: Skeins of Fate
88c671a2e1a1.plain: Blessing: if this power is manifested, pick one of your <LEGION> TZEENTCH units within 18" of this PSYKER. Until your next Psychic phase starts, that unit's models get a 4+ invulnerable save.

8a97bca55113.name: Chosen
8a97bca55113.plain: As soon as this unit destroys its first enemy unit, it counts as engaged in Wanton Destruction, Wanton Massacre and Wanton Slaughter for the rest of the battle.

8bbf196e068e.name: Hideous Regeneration
8bbf196e068e.plain: Whenever an enemy unit shoots or fights, once it has finished its attacks, any model in this unit that lost wounds from those attacks but wasn't destroyed immediately regains all its lost wounds.

8bfe8cfc0a05.name: Power Overload
8bfe8cfc0a05.plain: Within a single phase, if 3 or more of this model's hit rolls with lascannons or twin lascannons are a 1, it overloads and suffers 6 mortal wounds.

8c65f4785df7.name: Great plague cleaver
8c65f4785df7.plain: Plague Weapon. You must subtract 1 from the hit roll of every attack made with this weapon.

8d0d12f283e3.name: Cultist sniper rifle
8d0d12f283e3.plain: When you pick targets for this weapon, you can ignore the Look Out, Sir! rule. For each attack with this weapon, an unmodified wound roll of 6 deals 1 mortal wound to the target as well as any normal damage.

8d2183db7892.name: Soporific Gaze
8d2183db7892.plain: At the start of the Fight phase: pick one of your EMPEROR'S CHILDREN CHARACTER models, then pick one enemy unit within 3" of it. That enemy unit can't fight this phase until every eligible unit from your army has fought.

8d5192a5472a.name: Auto-stimulants
8d5192a5472a.plain: At the start of your Charge phase: pick one of your CREATIONS OF BILE CORE units. For the rest of the phase, it can declare a charge even if it Advanced this turn.

8e2e5dafa79c.name: Hellforged typhoon missile launcher
8e2e5dafa79c.plain: Choose which of the profiles below to attack with before you select targets.

8f3b0d3b1cd1.name: Heavy chainaxe
8f3b0d3b1cd1.plain: Subtract 1 from the hit roll for every attack made with this weapon.

8f59eb652b8f.name: Titanic Daemon Engine
8f59eb652b8f.plain: This model can declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back. Whenever it makes a Normal Move, Advances or Falls Back, it can move across other models (except MONSTER and VEHICLE models) as if they weren't there, and while doing so it can move within Engagement Range of those models, but it can't end its move within Engagement Range of any of them.

917db41987c7.name: Daemon Shells
917db41987c7.plain: In your Shooting phase, when one of your TRAITORIS ASTARTES units is chosen to shoot. For the rest of the phase: every bolt weapon the models in that unit have gets 6" added to its Range characteristic; and each time one of its models makes a ranged attack with a bolt weapon, improve that attack's Armour Penetration characteristic by 1.

919e7457b1b4.name: Aspire to Glory (Aura)
919e7457b1b4.plain: Aura: while one of your <LEGION> CORE units is within 6" of this model, re-roll wound rolls of 1 for attacks made by models in that unit.

9346b734d3d5.name: Explodes (Chaos Rhino)
9346b734d3d5.plain: If this TRANSPORT model is destroyed, roll a D6 before any models embarked in it disembark and before taking it off the battlefield. On a 6, it explodes and every unit within 6" takes D3 mortal wounds.

93f036ef591d.name: Excess of Violence
93f036ef591d.plain: In your Command phase, if your army is engaged in Wanton Destruction or Wanton Massacre: pick one of your EMPEROR'S CHILDREN INFANTRY units. Until your next Command phase starts, that unit counts as engaged in Wanton Slaughter instead.

9419cbffd273.name: Monstrous Visages
9419cbffd273.plain: In the Fight phase, when one of your CREATIONS OF BILE CHARACTER, CREATIONS OF BILE CORE or CREATIONS OF BILE DAEMONKIN units is chosen as the target of an attack. For the rest of the phase, whenever an attack is made against that unit, subtract 1 from its hit roll.

943e81e23bc5.name: Lord of the Ezekarion
943e81e23bc5.plain: After you choose a BLACK LEGION CHARACTER model to be your WARLORD (not a named character and not a DAEMON model): that CHARACTER model gets one extra Black Legion Warlord Trait. Every Warlord Trait in your army must be different (re-roll duplicates if you generate them randomly). You can use this Stratagem only once.

958246953f92.name: Explodes (6"/2D6/Transport)
958246953f92.plain: If this transport is destroyed, roll a D6 before any models embarked in it disembark and before taking it off the battlefield. On a 6, it explodes and every unit within 6" takes 2D6 mortal wounds.

959aaf3fd8e2.name: Explodes (2D6"/D6/Transport)
959aaf3fd8e2.plain: If this transport is destroyed, roll a D6 before any models embarked in it disembark and before taking it off the battlefield. On a 6, it explodes and every unit within 2D6" takes D6 mortal wounds.

97d013d95ec6.name: Brutal Subjugation
97d013d95ec6.plain: At the start of the Fight phase: pick one of your BRINGERS OF DESPAIR units. In the following Morale phase, each enemy model this unit destroys during this phase counts as 2 models.

985c40837abe.name: Nurglings' claws and teeth
985c40837abe.plain: Each time the bearer fights, it gets D6 extra attacks with this weapon, and it can make only those D6 attacks with this weapon. Re-roll a wound roll of 1 for attacks made with this weapon.

996f0624fe66.name: Siege Crawler
996f0624fe66.plain: When this unit makes a charge roll, you may ignore any or all of the modifiers to it.

9b13e074a9b4.name: Accursed weapon
9b13e074a9b4.plain: Whenever the bearer fights, it gets 1 extra attack with this weapon.

9beb5188c948.name: Infernal Engines
9beb5188c948.plain: At the start of your Charge phase: pick one of your SOULFORGED PACK DAEMON ENGINE models. It can charge this phase even if it Advanced earlier this turn.

9bf7266719d8.name: Devastation Battery
9bf7266719d8.plain: When you choose your army: pick one Chaos Space Marine Detachment in your army to be a Devastation Battery Specialist Detachment. The <LEGION> CHAOS LORDS, WARPSMITHS, HAVOCS and OBLITERATORS in it get the DEVASTATION BATTERY keyword.

9e4bb4983157.name: Hellforged hunter-killer missile
9e4bb4983157.plain: Each hellforged hunter-killer missile the bearer has can be fired only once per battle.

9ecdcfb7b2ca.name: Frenzy
9ecdcfb7b2ca.plain: While this model has 7 or fewer wounds left, re-roll wound rolls of 1 for its attacks.

9f10018e785e.name: Mark of Chaos Ascendant
9f10018e785e.plain:
This model gets all of these:
- When it makes a melee attack, add 1 to that attack's Strength if this turn it charged, was charged or made a Heroic Intervention.
- Once per turn, the first time this model fails a saving throw, that attack's Damage becomes 0.
- When an attack targets this model and the attack's Strength is equal to or at least double this model's Toughness, subtract 1 from the wound roll.
- If this model begins the Fight phase within Engagement Range of any enemy models, it fights first that phase.

9f268c8c577c.name: Hyper-growth Bolts
9f268c8c577c.plain:
Model with a bolt weapon only. When you give this Relic to a model, pick one bolt weapon the bearer has:
- That weapon counts as a Relic for all rules purposes.
- Each time the bearer is chosen to shoot, you can have that weapon fire a hyper-growth bolt. If you do, the bearer can make only one attack with that weapon this phase, but if that attack hits, then unless the target is a VEHICLE unit, it automatically wounds, has an Armour Penetration of -1 and has a Damage of D3+3.

9f43f646c2ad.name: Twin Helfrost Cannon (Dispersed Beam)
9f43f646c2ad.plain: If this weapon inflicts any unsaved wounds on a model and that model survives, roll a D6. On a 6, the target suffers 1 mortal wound.

a0c3d7f0121c.name: Fury of Khorne
a0c3d7f0121c.plain: In the Fight phase, when one of your TRAITORIS ASTARTES KHORNE units is chosen to fight. For the rest of the phase, an unmodified hit roll of 6 automatically wounds the target whenever a model in that unit attacks in melee.

a12e96710c9e.name: Runes of the Blood God
a12e96710c9e.plain: Roll one D6 whenever this model is picked as the target of a psychic power or would take mortal wounds because of one. On a 4+, the psychic power has no effect on this model.

a1be59e03b18.name: Chainsword
a1be59e03b18.plain: Each time the bearer fights, it gets 1 extra attack with this weapon.

a1bf4bcc9138.name: Airborne Predator
a1bf4bcc9138.plain: When this model declares a charge, only AIRCRAFT units can be its targets. Only a unit that can FLY can choose this model as a charge target. It can only fight if it is in Engagement Range of an enemy unit that can FLY, and its melee attacks can only target units that can FLY. Enemy units that can't FLY can't make melee attacks against this unit.

a2173309447f.name: Maelstrom's Bite
a2173309447f.plain: Before choosing targets, pick one or both of the profiles below to attack with. If you pick both, subtract 1 from the hit roll of every attack made with this weapon this phase.

a2bf47310886.name: Bitter Enmity
a2bf47310886.plain: In the Fight phase, when one of your IRON WARRIORS units is chosen to fight. For the rest of the phase, whenever a HERETIC ASTARTES model in that unit attacks in melee against an IMPERIAL FISTS unit or a unit from an Imperial Fists successor Chapter, you can re-roll both the hit roll and the wound roll.

a3973b9f99f6.name: Claws of the Stygian Count
a3973b9f99f6.plain: Each time the bearer fights, it gets 2 extra attacks with this weapon. When an attack with this weapon is allocated to an enemy model, that model can't use any rules that ignore wounds it loses.

a3fabec6e75d.name: The Warmaster
a3fabec6e75d.plain: If your army is Battle-forged, you must pick this model as your WARLORD.

a40b7b88e750.name: Hellforged Dreadnought chainfist
a40b7b88e750.plain: Attacks from this weapon that are allocated to a VEHICLE model have a Damage characteristic of 6.

a50d362c0916.name: Laser volley cannon - Overcharge fire
a50d362c0916.plain: For every attack with this profile that gets an unmodified hit roll of 1, the bearer suffers 1 mortal wound after it has finished shooting with this weapon, unless it Remained Stationary in your previous Movement phase.

a53f8b70befb.name: Gift of Chaos
a53f8b70befb.plain: Witchfire: if this power is manifested, the nearest enemy unit that is within 18" of this PSYKER and visible to it suffers D3 mortal wounds. Then roll one D6 for each other enemy unit within 6" of that unit; on a 4+, that unit suffers 1 mortal wound.

a656cd134562.name: From the Night
a656cd134562.plain: In the Reinforcements step of your Movement phase: pick one of your NIGHT LORDS INFANTRY or NIGHT LORDS BIKER units that is in Strategic Reserves, or is a Reinforcements unit not yet set up on the battlefield. It can now be set up as though the battle round were 1 higher than it actually is, regardless of any mission rules. This Stratagem costs 2 CP if that unit has the DAEMONKIN keyword, otherwise 1 CP.

a847d22ff342.name: Dark Pact
a847d22ff342.plain: In any phase, when one of your WORD BEARERS INFANTRY CHARACTER models is destroyed: instead of using any other rules triggered by its destruction, you can have that model make a dark pact. If you do, mark where the model was and take it off the battlefield. When the phase ends, roll one D6: on a 4+, put the model back on the battlefield with D3 wounds remaining, as close as possible to the marked position and not within Engagement Range of any enemy units. Each model can be picked for this Stratagem only once per battle.

a886c379a766.name: Power scourge
a886c379a766.plain: Whenever the bearer fights, it gets 3 extra attacks with this weapon.

a90cd257f91a.name: The Black Mace
a90cd257f91a.plain: For attacks made with this weapon, excess damage is not lost. Keep allocating it to other models in the target unit until there is no excess damage left to allocate or the target unit is destroyed.

a9a54036aba1.name: Cabbalistic Rituals
a9a54036aba1.plain:
Your army is a Cabal of Sorcerers if every unit in it, not counting UNALIGNED units, has the THOUSAND SONS keyword. If it is, then at the start of each of your Psychic phases you gain Cabal points for every model on the battlefield that has this ability: Magnus the Red gives 4; Ahriman, an Exalted Sorcerer or a Thousand Sons Daemon Prince gives 3; a Sorcerer, Sorcerer in Terminator Armour or Infernal Master gives 2; a Scarab Occult Sorcerer, Aspiring Sorcerer or Tzaangor Shaman gives 1.

During your Psychic phase you may spend Cabal points on the Cabbalistic Rituals listed below, taking each ritual's cost off your total. Unspent Cabal points are lost when your Psychic phase ends.

Each Cabbalistic Ritual can be used once in your Psychic phase unless it says otherwise, and no unit of yours can benefit from more than one Cabbalistic Ritual. A unit without this ability can't benefit from a Cabbalistic Ritual.

If a ritual's timing mentions a 'unit from your army' (such as one used when a unit from your army is chosen to manifest psychic powers), that unit must have the THOUSAND SONS keyword for you to use it.

IMBUED MANIFESTATION (costs 4 Cabal points): use when one of your units successfully manifests a psychic power. The range of that power's effects goes up by 6" (if the power lists more than one range, such as Astral Blast, add 6" to the first range it lists).

MALEVOLENT CHARGE (costs 4 Cabal points): use when one of your units successfully manifests a psychic power. If that power inflicts mortal wounds on enemy units, once those mortal wounds are dealt, pick one of those units; it suffers D3 more mortal wounds.

KINDRED SORCERERS (costs 5 Cabal points): use after one of your units takes a Psychic test. Add 1 to that test.

WARP SIGHT (costs 3 Cabal points): use when one of your units successfully manifests a psychic power. If that power needs you to pick a unit visible to the PSYKER, for this manifestation you may pick a unit that any friendly unit with the Cabbalistic Rituals ability can see.

ECHOES FROM THE WARP (costs 4 Cabal points): use in your Psychic phase. Choose one of your PSYKER units. Until the phase ends, it can perform this psychic action: Echoes From the Warp (Warp Charge 3, Psychic Action): if it succeeds, you gain 1 Command point.

PACT FROM BEYOND (costs 7 Cabal points): use when one of your units attempts to manifest a psychic power. Don't take a Psychic test; the test counts as passed at the lowest warp charge value it needed.

CABBALISTIC FOCUS (costs 8 Cabal points): use after one of your units passes a Psychic test. That psychic power or psychic action can't be denied.

PSYCHIC MAELSTROM (costs 8 Cabal points): use when one of your units is chosen to manifest psychic powers. Until the phase ends, that unit may try to manifest one Witchfire psychic power that a different PSYKER from your army already attempted this phase, even if the unit doesn't know it and even though the same power normally can't be attempted more than once per Psychic phase.

WRATH OF THE IMMATERIUM (costs 9 Cabal points): use after one of your units takes a Psychic test. Add 2 to that test.

waive.MODELCABAL: table header 'MODEL / CABAL POINTS' run together in the source; the plain text lists each model's Cabal points instead

aa3383d6c39c.name: Fanatic Zealotry
aa3383d6c39c.plain: In your Command phase: pick one of your WORD BEARERS CULTISTS units that is within 12" of a friendly WORD BEARERS CHARACTER unit. Until your next Command phase starts: you can re-roll charge rolls for that unit; and whenever one of its models makes a melee attack, you can re-roll the hit roll.

aae5d79896da.name: Relentless Hatred
aae5d79896da.plain: When an attack is allocated to this model, its Damage characteristic is reduced by 1, but not below 1.

ab5957cff823.name: Bringers of Despair
ab5957cff823.plain: When you choose your army: pick one BLACK LEGION Detachment in your army to be a Bringers of Despair Specialist Detachment. The BLACK LEGION TERMINATOR units in it get the BRINGERS OF DESPAIR keyword.

ac9875bd004a.name: Sorcerer
ac9875bd004a.plain: Knows Smite plus 2 powers from the Dark Hereticus discipline.

acfe58a4698e.name: Cruel Bladesmen
acfe58a4698e.plain: In the Fight phase, when one of your EMPEROR'S CHILDREN units is chosen to fight. For the rest of the phase, whenever a HERETIC ASTARTES model in that unit attacks in melee, improve the attack's Armour Penetration characteristic by 1.

ad0540adc721.name: Drach'nyen
ad0540adc721.plain: Each time an attack is made with this weapon, an unmodified wound roll of 6 inflicts D3 mortal wounds on the target as well as the normal damage.

ad116eafd5aa.name: Mutant Rabble
ad116eafd5aa.plain: Ignore destroyed Mutant models when taking Morale tests.

ae3c33567e00.name: Renascent Infiltration
ae3c33567e00.plain: In your Movement phase, when you pick one of your ALPHA LEGION INFANTRY units to move while it is more than 6" away from all enemy models: if your mission uses the Strategic Reserves rule, put that unit into Strategic Reserves. It can't arrive from Strategic Reserves in the turn it was put there.

aea4c0fa4af3.name: Power of the Machine Spirit
aea4c0fa4af3.plain: When this model moves and then shoots Heavy weapons, it ignores the hit roll penalty for doing so.

aeeb10046c70.name: Rites of Possession (Aura)
aeeb10046c70.plain: Aura: each time an enemy unit within 12" of this model suffers Perils of the Warp, it suffers 1 extra mortal wound.

af350453fe07.name: Head Taker
af350453fe07.plain: Each time an attack by this model destroys an enemy CHARACTER unit, for the rest of the battle add 1 to this model's Attacks, and the range of its Herald of the Apocalypse ability increases by 6" (up to a maximum of 24").

af7fc0221e86.name: Mindwitch
af7fc0221e86.plain: Whenever this unit's MINDWITCH model attempts to manifest a psychic power, Deny the Witch or perform a psychic action, measure range and line of sight from it. When enemy abilities need distance or line of sight measured to PSYKER units, measure them to this unit's MINDWITCH model.

b21cfe548fe4.name: Cursed Earth
b21cfe548fe4.plain:
Blessing (Aura): if this power is manifested, then until your next Psychic phase starts, while one of your <LEGION> DAEMONKIN or <LEGION> DAEMON ENGINE units is within 6" of this PSYKER:
- That unit's DAEMONKIN and DAEMON ENGINE models get a 4+ invulnerable save.
- Whenever an enemy unit ends a charge within Engagement Range of that unit, roll a D6. On a 2-4 the enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound; on a 5+ it suffers D3 mortal wounds.

b3283d09454f.name: Death to the False Emperor!
b3283d09454f.plain: In the Fight phase, when one of your TRAITORIS ASTARTES units is chosen to fight. Until the phase ends, whenever one of that unit's HERETIC ASTARTES models attacks an ADEPTUS ASTARTES or SANCTIC ASTARTES unit in melee, you may re-roll that hit roll.

b463b17013f1.name: Hellflamer
b463b17013f1.plain: Attacks made with this weapon hit their target automatically.

b4d80baac617.name: Infernal bomb
b4d80baac617.plain: Once per turn, the bearer can drop one of its remaining infernal bombs (if it has any left). Immediately after it moves, choose a point on the battlefield that it passed over this phase. Roll one D6 for every unit within 6" of that point, taking 1 off the roll if it is a CHARACTER (excluding VEHICLE or MONSTER units). A unit takes D3 mortal wounds on a 4-5, or D6 mortal wounds on a 6. No infernal bomb can be dropped more than once per battle. As updated in January 2023, this ability only works if the bearer is still on the battlefield at the end of its move.

b5bddd0f8adb.name: Diseased claws and fangs
b5bddd0f8adb.plain: Re-roll wound rolls of 1 for attacks made with this weapon.

b6c26926850e.name: Big Target
b6c26926850e.plain:
While this unit contains a TRAITOR OGRYN model:
- Attacks that target this unit use that model's Toughness characteristic for their wound rolls.
- Any attack allocated to a model in this unit has to be allocated to that model.
- Any mortal wound inflicted on this unit has to be suffered by that model.

b725b68e3730.name: Shroud of Flies
b725b68e3730.plain: At the start of your opponent's Shooting phase: pick one of your TRAITORIS ASTARTES NURGLE units. For the rest of the phase, whenever an enemy model shoots, it can't target that NURGLE unit while that shooting is resolved, unless the NURGLE unit is the closest eligible target or is within 12" of that model. This Stratagem costs 3 CP if the NURGLE unit has any of the MONSTER, VEHICLE, TERMINATOR or BIKER keywords, otherwise 2 CP.

b795e0de0282.name: Armour of Abhorrence (Aura)
b795e0de0282.plain: Aura: each time an enemy unit (other than a TITANIC unit) within 3" of the bearer is chosen to Fall Back, roll one D6; on a 4+ it cannot Fall Back this turn.

b7c43a8615b9.name: Chosen Enforcers
b7c43a8615b9.plain: When one of your HERETIC ASTARTES units within 18" of one of your BRINGERS OF DESPAIR units has to take a Morale test: it passes that test automatically.

b80755ad6e21.name: Terrax melta cutter
b80755ad6e21.plain: Attacks from this weapon against a unit within half range have Damage D6+2.

b9ecd909a93d.name: Forge Surge
b9ecd909a93d.plain: In your Shooting phase, when one of your DAEMON ENGINE models (not a TITANIC model) is chosen to shoot. For the rest of the phase, don't roll for the number of attacks made with any of that model's weapons; make the maximum number of attacks with them instead.

bb67f1170433.name: Blight Grenades
bb67f1170433.plain: Blast. Wound rolls of 1 for this weapon can be re-rolled.

bb99e024a5b3.name: Infernal Engine
bb99e024a5b3.plain: In your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when one of your TRAITORIS ASTARTES DAEMON ENGINE models is chosen as the target of an attack. For the rest of the phase, whenever an attack is allocated to that model, reduce that attack's Damage characteristic by 1 (to a minimum of 1). This Stratagem costs 2 CP if that model has the TITANIC keyword, otherwise 1 CP.

bc013c4df4cd.name: Icons of Destruction
bc013c4df4cd.plain: Every model in this unit has a 4+ invulnerable save.

bcc5cdd0515b.name: Daemon Engine
bcc5cdd0515b.plain: This model has a 5+ invulnerable save. It also regains 1 lost wound in your Command phase.

bd1be49ca9d1.name: Hatred Eternal
bd1be49ca9d1.plain: At the end of either your Shooting phase or the Fight phase: pick one of your LEGIONARIES units. In the Shooting phase, that unit can shoot again. In the Fight phase, if it is within Engagement Range of any enemy units, it can fight again.

bd6aa197cb8a.name: Boreas air defence missiles
bd6aa197cb8a.plain: Add 2 to the hit roll of attacks this weapon makes against an AIRCRAFT model, and its attacks that are allocated to an AIRCRAFT model have Damage D3+3.

be6817c4c1c7.name: Excessive Cruelty
be6817c4c1c7.plain: When an enemy unit that is within Engagement Range of one of your TRAITORIS ASTARTES SLAANESH units Falls Back. Once that enemy unit has finished its move, pick one of your TRAITORIS ASTARTES SLAANESH units that was within Engagement Range of it when you used this Stratagem. That SLAANESH unit can either consolidate up to 3", or, if no enemy units are within Engagement Range of it any more, shoot as if it were your Shooting phase. If it shoots, its only allowed target is the enemy unit that Fell Back (and only if that unit is an eligible target).

bfaee6b897c8.name: Mark of Khorne
bfaee6b897c8.plain:
- When a model in this unit makes a melee attack, add 1 to its Strength if the unit charged, was charged or made a Heroic Intervention this turn.
- If this unit has the ICON keyword, improve the Armour Penetration of its models' melee attacks by 1.

c26b8c627f9b.name: Trophy-taker
c26b8c627f9b.plain: You can re-roll the wound roll for any melee attack this model makes against an enemy CHARACTER unit.

c2faa556416a.name: Combat Elixirs
c2faa556416a.plain: When one of your EMPEROR'S CHILDREN CORE or EMPEROR'S CHILDREN CHARACTER units is chosen to fight. Until the phase ends, add 1 to the Strength characteristic of that unit's models and improve their Weapon Skill characteristic by 1.

c30f6483fc75.name: Mark of Nurgle
c30f6483fc75.plain:
- When an attack targets this unit and the attack's Strength is equal to or at least double this unit's Toughness, subtract 1 from the wound roll.
- While this unit has the ICON keyword, an unmodified hit roll of 6 for a ranged attack by one of its models wounds the target automatically.

c32d7c206d2f.name: Cold-hearted Malignity
c32d7c206d2f.plain: At the start of any phase: pick one of your IRON WARRIORS CORE units that is below Half-strength. For the rest of the battle: it passes Morale tests automatically; and whenever one of its models attacks, add 1 to the hit roll.

c34e0287e7df.name: Glitchcurse
c34e0287e7df.plain: In your opponent's Shooting phase, when an enemy unit that is within 18" of your WARLORD and visible to it has finished making its attacks: if any of those attacks targeted one of your TRAITORIS ASTARTES units within 6" of your WARLORD, roll one D6. That enemy unit suffers D3 mortal wounds on a 2-4, or 3 mortal wounds on a 5+.

c3ab9362df57.name: Scuttling Gait
c3ab9362df57.plain: When this model Advances, don't make an Advance roll; instead, its Move characteristic is increased by 6" until the end of the phase.

c3f061300224.name: Termite drill
c3f061300224.plain: Attacks from this weapon that are allocated to a VEHICLE model have Damage D3+6.

c4beacd34f5f.name: Unholy Speed
c4beacd34f5f.plain: Whenever you make a charge roll for this unit, you can re-roll it.

c5f760e9673f.name: Impaler harpoon
c5f760e9673f.plain: If a model (other than an AIRCRAFT model) loses any wounds from an attack by this weapon but survives, it is impaled until your next Shooting phase starts. An impaled model has its Move characteristic halved, and when a charge roll is made for the bearer, add 2 to that roll if that charge targets the impaled model's unit.

c6c7f0a26b1e.name: Armour of Shrieking Souls
c6c7f0a26b1e.plain: This model has a 4+ invulnerable save. If an attack by an enemy model destroys this model, your opponent has to roll 2D6. If the total is lower than that enemy model's Leadership, the enemy model's unit suffers D3 mortal wounds; if not, it suffers D6 mortal wounds. Either way, in a Crusade battle, the enemy model's unit has to take an Out of Action test when the battle ends, even if it was not destroyed.

c71ebf7913ac.name: Airborne
c71ebf7913ac.plain: This model can't declare a charge, and only a unit that can FLY can choose it as a charge target. It can only fight if it is in Engagement Range of an enemy unit that can FLY, and its melee attacks can only target units that can FLY. Enemy units that can't FLY can't make melee attacks against this model.

c740282384b5.name: Corrupt Machine Spirits
c740282384b5.plain:
In your Command phase, this model can choose to corrupt one enemy VEHICLE model within 9", or else one of your <LEGION> VEHICLE models within 9":
- Corrupting an enemy model: roll as many D6 as that model's Wounds characteristic; for each 6, that model's unit suffers 1 mortal wound, up to a maximum of 6 mortal wounds.
- Corrupting a friendly model: until your next Command phase starts, add 1 to the hit roll of each melee attack that model makes.
No model can be corrupted more than once per turn.

c7ab33a28509.name: Infernal Gaze
c7ab33a28509.plain: Witchfire: if this power is manifested, pick one enemy unit within 18" of this PSYKER that it can see, and roll three D6 (or six D6 instead if the Psychic test was an unmodified 10+). That unit suffers 1 mortal wound for each 4+ rolled.

c7f0aa7ae40d.name: Axe of the Forgemaster
c7f0aa7ae40d.plain: Each time an attack is made with this weapon, an unmodified wound roll of 6 inflicts 1 mortal wound on the target on top of any normal damage (or 3 mortal wounds instead, plus normal damage, if the target is a VEHICLE unit).

c8717ed7b109.name: Explodes
c8717ed7b109.plain: If this model is destroyed, roll a D6 before any models embarked in it disembark and before taking it off the battlefield. On a 6, it explodes and every unit within 2D6" takes D6 mortal wounds.

c878dc4f1e3c.name: Vicious Descent
c878dc4f1e3c.plain: In your Charge phase, when one of your TRAITORIS ASTARTES JUMP PACK units finishes a charge move: pick one enemy unit within Engagement Range of it. For each model in that JUMP PACK unit within Engagement Range of the enemy unit, roll one D6. For every roll equal to or higher than that enemy unit's Toughness characteristic, it suffers 1 mortal wound.

c9a7d30cb388.name: Methodical Annihilation
c9a7d30cb388.plain:
In your Shooting phase, when one of your IRON WARRIORS units is chosen to shoot. For the rest of the phase:
- You can re-roll one damage roll when resolving that unit's attacks.
- Whenever one of its models attacks with a Blast weapon, count the target unit as having double its number of models when working out how many attacks that weapon makes.
- If it is a VEHICLE unit, it can attack units within Engagement Range with Blast weapons. If it does, then each time it attacks with a Blast weapon this phase, an unmodified hit roll of 1 means that unit suffers 1 mortal wound once all of its attacks have been resolved.

cbb303f7d683.name: Warpflames
cbb303f7d683.plain: Whenever an enemy unit (other than MONSTER and VEHICLE units) in Engagement Range of this unit is chosen to Fall Back, you and your opponent roll off. If you win, that unit can't Fall Back this turn.

cc05ae4a8cdf.name: Cakospark Prattle
cc05ae4a8cdf.plain: After your opponent uses a Stratagem other than Command Re-roll, if your WARLORD is on the battlefield: for the rest of the battle, your opponent pays 1 more CP each time they use that Stratagem again. You can use this Stratagem only once.

cca0ae9f805b.name: Mark of Slaanesh
cca0ae9f805b.plain: This unit fights first in the Fight phase if, when that phase starts, it is within Engagement Range of any enemy models.

ccc86fb955ae.name: Daemon Prince
ccc86fb955ae.plain: Knows Smite plus 1 power from the Dark Hereticus discipline.

ccfde194cd27.name: Chorus of the True Faith
ccfde194cd27.plain: When one of your CULT OF THE DAMNED DARK APOSTLE models chants a prayer: if any friendly CULT OF THE DAMNED CHAOS CULTISTS units are within 6" of that Dark Apostle, add 1 to the roll to see whether the prayer is heard.

cd4f3f8cb5fb.name: Blade of the Relentless
cd4f3f8cb5fb.plain: The bearer can make 1 extra attack with this weapon each time it fights. When an attack with this weapon gets an unmodified hit roll of 6, it inflicts 2 mortal wounds on the target and ends the attack sequence.

cd5cdfca2ea1.name: Putrid Miasma
cd5cdfca2ea1.plain: Blessing: if this power is manifested, pick one of your <LEGION> NURGLE units within 18" of this PSYKER. Until your next Psychic phase starts, subtract 1 from the hit roll of each attack made against that unit.

ce16e00fc22d.name: Daemonic Machine Spirit
ce16e00fc22d.plain: This model ignores the -1 hit roll penalty for shooting Heavy weapons after it has moved.

ceca730b28a6.name: Explodes
ceca730b28a6.plain: If this model is destroyed, roll a D6 before any models embarked in it disembark and before taking it off the battlefield. On a 6, it explodes and every unit within 6" takes 2D6 mortal wounds.

cf35c5814923.name: Staff of Possession
cf35c5814923.plain: Each time the bearer fights, if this weapon had any of its attacks allocated to a PSYKER model, then after the bearer has resolved all its attacks, that PSYKER model must suffer Perils of the Warp.

cfb4ca9137ac.name: Plague spewer
cfb4ca9137ac.plain: Plague Weapon. Attacks made with this weapon hit the target automatically.

d073bde18ae7.name: Balefire tome
d073bde18ae7.plain: This unit knows Smite plus 1 power from the Dark Hereticus discipline.

d0df99555e80.name: Without a Trace
d0df99555e80.plain: At the start of your opponent's Shooting phase: pick one of your FALLEN ANGELS units that is entirely on or within a terrain feature. For the rest of the phase, subtract 1 from the hit roll whenever an enemy model attacks that unit.

d10ad733a87c.name: Let the Galaxy Burn
d10ad733a87c.plain: This model has the Let the Galaxy Burn army rule, explained in this faction's army rules.

waive.145: page number of the book reference, not a rule value

d1854267f4fa.name: Contempt Over Caution
d1854267f4fa.plain:
In your Shooting phase: pick one of your <LEGION> CORE units that is not within Engagement Range of any enemy units, then pick one enemy unit. Until the end of the phase:
- Models in your <LEGION> unit can target that enemy unit even while it is within Engagement Range of other friendly units, as long as all of those other friendly units are <LEGION> units.
- Each time a model in your <LEGION> unit attacks that enemy unit, you can't re-roll the hit roll. On an unmodified hit roll of 1, the attack instead hits one friendly <LEGION> unit of your choice that is within Engagement Range of that enemy unit. Resolve attacks against friendly units after the attacks that hit the enemy unit.
This Stratagem costs 1 CP if every <LEGION> unit within Engagement Range of the enemy unit you picked was a CULTISTS unit, otherwise 2 CP.

d21c829bce3c.name: Enrage Machine Spirits
d21c829bce3c.plain: In your Command phase, this model can enrage one of your <LEGION> VEHICLE models within 3" of it. If it does, add 1 to the hit roll of each ranged attack that VEHICLE model makes until your next Command phase starts. A model can be enraged only once per turn.

d2b4b77a7b40.name: Malevolent Covenant
d2b4b77a7b40.plain: In your Psychic phase, when one of your WORD BEARERS PSYKER units fails a Psychic test: you can choose to have that PSYKER unit suffer 1 mortal wound; if you do, this Stratagem costs 1 CP, otherwise it costs 2 CP. Either way, the Psychic test counts as passed with the minimum warp charge value needed, with no double rolled, and it can't be denied by any Deny the Witch tests.

d36885ca5963.name: Blasphemous Machines
d36885ca5963.plain: In your Command phase: pick one of your TRAITORIS ASTARTES MACHINE SPIRIT or TRAITORIS ASTARTES DAEMON ENGINE models with a Wounds characteristic of 10 or more. Until your next Command phase starts, when working out which characteristics on its profile to use, treat that model as having all of its wounds remaining. This Stratagem costs 2 CP if that model has the TITANIC keyword, otherwise 1 CP.

d38c19806c06.name: Disc's blades
d38c19806c06.plain: Each time the bearer fights, it gets 1 extra attack with this weapon, and it can make no more than 1 attack with this weapon.

d4074c12500c.name: Explodes (6"/2D6)
d4074c12500c.plain: If this model is destroyed, roll a D6 before taking it off the battlefield. On a 6, it explodes and every unit within 6" takes 2D6 mortal wounds.

d52d3e1cb63f.name: Helspear
d52d3e1cb63f.plain: Whenever an attack with this weapon scores a hit, draw a straight line from the closest point of this model's base (or hull) to the closest point of the nearest model in the target unit. Then one wound roll is made against the target unit and each other unit the line crosses.

d553fd1dd5fb.name: Lord of Tzeentch (Aura)
d553fd1dd5fb.plain: Aura: while one of your <LEGION> TZEENTCH CORE units is within 6" of this model, re-roll hit rolls of 1 for attacks made by models in that unit.

d59bb81a8389.name: Daemonic (Daemon Prince)
d59bb81a8389.plain: Against ranged attacks this model has a 4+ invulnerable save; against melee attacks, its invulnerable save is 5+ instead.

d61746939776.name: Vengeance for Monarchia
d61746939776.plain: In the Fight phase, when one of your WORD BEARERS units is chosen to fight. For the rest of the phase, whenever a HERETIC ASTARTES model in that unit attacks in melee against an ULTRAMARINES unit or a unit from an Ultramarines successor Chapter, you can re-roll both the hit roll and the wound roll.

d6bcb1dabf49.name: Vessels for the Neverborn
d6bcb1dabf49.plain: At the start of the Fight phase: pick one of your DAEMONKIN RITUALISTS DAEMON units that has a friendly DAEMONKIN RITUALISTS MASTER OF POSSESSION within 6" of it. Until the phase ends, that unit's models get 1 added to both their Strength and Attacks characteristics.

d72ccfdb5a26.name: Fearsome (Aura)
d72ccfdb5a26.plain: Aura: subtract 1 from the Leadership of each enemy unit while it is within 6" of this model.

d734c37b96e3.name: Icon of despair
d734c37b96e3.plain: In your Morale phase, pick each enemy unit in Engagement Range of the bearer's unit and roll one D6 for it: on a 4+, the unit takes 1 mortal wound.

d97ece9f7a21.name: Fallen Angels
d97ece9f7a21.plain:
Before the battle, while mustering your army: your army can include one Fallen Angels Specialist Detachment. This is a Vanguard Detachment that may contain only FALLEN units, Sorcerer units and Chaos Rhino units.
In this Detachment, Sorcerer units lose their <MARK OF CHAOS>, HERETIC ASTARTES and <LEGION> Faction keywords and get the IMPERIUM and FALLEN Faction keywords in their place. Their Death to the False Emperor ability is swapped for the Fallen Angels ability (found on the Fallen datasheet).
In this Detachment, Chaos Rhino units also swap their <MARK OF CHAOS>, HERETIC ASTARTES and <LEGION> Faction keywords for the IMPERIUM and FALLEN Faction keywords. Their Transport section becomes: 'This model can transport 10 FALLEN INFANTRY models. It can't transport JUMP PACK models.'
Every unit in a Fallen Angels Specialist Detachment gains the FALLEN ANGELS keyword.

da334938d38b.name: Coils of Deception
da334938d38b.plain: In your Movement phase, when one of your ALPHA LEGION CORE units Falls Back: that unit can still shoot this turn despite having Fallen Back.

da5b5ae68ed5.name: Daemonforge Overdrive
da5b5ae68ed5.plain: At the start of the Fight phase: pick one of your SOULFORGED PACK DAEMON ENGINE models. When working out which characteristics to use from its damage table, treat it as having double its remaining wounds. This lasts until the phase ends or until the model is reduced to 0 wounds, whichever happens first.

db20cd75b6c8.name: Talon of Horus (melee)
db20cd75b6c8.plain: Each time an attack is made with this weapon, you make 2 attack rolls for it rather than 1.

db445932041a.name: Cursed Despoilers
db445932041a.plain: In your Shooting phase, when one of your WORD BEARERS CORE or WORD BEARERS DAEMONKIN units that is engaged in Wanton Massacre is chosen to shoot: pick one enemy unit within 12" of it that is in range of an objective marker. Whenever a HERETIC ASTARTES model in that WORD BEARERS unit attacks that enemy unit with a Rapid Fire, Assault or Pistol weapon, an unmodified hit roll of 4-5 scores 1 extra hit. Together with the Wanton Massacre bonus, this means an unmodified hit roll of 4+ scores 1 extra hit.

db60c9c4afe4.name: Black Rune of Damnation (Aura)
db60c9c4afe4.plain: Aura: while an enemy PSYKER unit is within 18" of the bearer, that unit suffers Perils of the Warp whenever it rolls any double on a Psychic test.

dcfe63320065.name: Warptime
dcfe63320065.plain:
Blessing: if this power is manifested, pick one of your <LEGION> INFANTRY or <LEGION> CHAOS SPAWN units within 6" of this PSYKER.
- It can make a Normal Move. If it Advanced during your previous Movement phase, it is still treated as having Advanced this turn.
- Until the turn ends, it can't declare a charge.

de00e8dc20c4.name: Foul Alterations
de00e8dc20c4.plain: In your Movement phase, when one of your DAEMON ENGINE units is chosen to Advance. Until the turn ends, it can still shoot and declare a charge this turn even though it Advanced.

dec167e0cb2a.name: Rain Fire and Death
dec167e0cb2a.plain: In your Command phase, if one of your RED CORSAIRS CHARACTER units is on the battlefield: choose a point on the battlefield and put a marker there. When your next Command phase starts, roll a D6 for each unit within 6" of that marker's centre. Add 1 to the roll if the unit is within 3" of the marker's centre, and subtract 1 if it is a Character unit. On a 2-5, the unit suffers D3 mortal wounds; on a 6+, it suffers D6 mortal wounds. Then remove the marker. You can use this Stratagem only once.

dec74ee916ee.name: Smokescreen
dec74ee916ee.plain: In your opponent's Shooting phase, when one of your TRAITORIS ASTARTES SMOKESCREEN units is chosen as the target of an attack. For the rest of the phase, whenever an attack is made against that unit, subtract 1 from its hit roll.

e0790ff29b6d.name: Mindless Fodder
e0790ff29b6d.plain: This unit automatically passes every Morale test it takes.

e1742766ca6c.name: Underhand Scheming
e1742766ca6c.plain: At the start of your Charge phase: pick one of your NIGHT LORDS units. For the rest of the phase, it can declare a charge even if it Fell Back this turn.

e1a4a2e0c931.name: Thermal jet array
e1a4a2e0c931.plain: Once the bearer has moved, you may choose one unit this model moved over and roll one D6, taking 1 off the roll if the unit has the CHARACTER keyword. On a 2-4, the unit suffers D3 mortal wounds; on a 5+, it suffers 2D3 mortal wounds.

e1e4b25fd7a1.name: The Masters Are Watching
e1e4b25fd7a1.plain: In the Command phase: pick one of your CREATIONS OF BILE INFANTRY units, then pick one friendly CREATIONS OF BILE CHARACTER model that is visible to it. Until the turn ends, that INFANTRY unit counts as being in range of any or all of these aura abilities the CHARACTER model has: Lord of Chaos, Aspire to Glory, Demagogue.

e21430bf4df0.name: Bile maw
e21430bf4df0.plain: Attacks made with this weapon hit the target automatically, and you re-roll wound rolls of 1 for them.

e25dc10edbb9.name: Explorator augury web
e25dc10edbb9.plain: Enemy units set up on the battlefield as Reinforcements can't be set up within 12" of the bearer. The bearer's transport capacity is 6 <LEGION> INFANTRY models instead of 10.

e2e1c8502f8e.name: Accursed Horde
e2e1c8502f8e.plain:
This unit can't perform actions and can't embark within TRANSPORT models. When your Command phase starts, you may pick one of these:
- Add back up to 3 of this unit's destroyed Mutant models.
- Add back one of its destroyed Torment models, with all its wounds.

e3d0632716c1.name: Ritual Offerings
e3d0632716c1.plain: In the Fight phase, when an attack by one of your CULT OF THE DAMNED CHAOS CULTISTS units destroys an enemy model: for the rest of the battle, that Chaos Cultist unit passes Morale tests automatically.

e47df13703da.name: The Chirurgeon
e47df13703da.plain: Each time the bearer fights, it gets 4 extra attacks with this weapon.

e5022762686a.name: Daemon Weapon
e5022762686a.plain: Each time the bearer is chosen to fight, roll 2D6. If the total is equal to or below the bearer's Leadership characteristic, it fights as normal. If not, you must pick one of these: the bearer suffers D3 mortal wounds and then fights normally; or, until that fight is resolved, the bearer can't make attacks with any daemon weapons it has.

e52a3286bf84.name: Trophies of Slaughter (Aura)
e52a3286bf84.plain: Aura: subtract 1 from each Combat Attrition test taken for an enemy unit while it is within 9" of the bearer.

e5750bca9f01.name: Priest
e5750bca9f01.plain: The DARK APOSTLE model in this unit knows Dark Zealotry and one more prayer from the Prayers to the Dark Gods. During your Command phase, the DARK APOSTLE can try to chant one prayer it knows, as long as no friendly model has already attempted that prayer this turn. Roll a D6; if you get 3+, the prayer is heard, and it takes effect until your next Command phase starts. For any heard prayer that this unit's DARK APOSTLE chanted, distances and line of sight are measured from that model.

e5da92b95876.name: Storm Eagle multi-melta
e5da92b95876.plain: Attacks from this weapon against a unit within half range have Damage D6+2.

e7099c36af54.name: The Ashen Axe
e7099c36af54.plain: Each time the bearer fights, if an attack made by this weapon destroyed any enemy models, roll 2D6. If the total is equal to or greater than the Leadership of the destroyed model's unit, then for the rest of the battle that unit can't Advance or Fall Back, and it can't fight in the Fight phase until every eligible unit from your army has fought.

e87aaf7dcbb5.name: Subterranean Assault
e87aaf7dcbb5.plain: At deployment, you may put this model underground instead of on the battlefield. If you do, in the Reinforcements step of any one of your Movement phases, it can be placed anywhere on the battlefield that is more than 9" from all enemy models. Models embarked in it may then disembark, but must be placed more than 9" from all enemy models.

e95ffb727c7e.name: Death to the False Emperor
e95ffb727c7e.plain: When a model with this ability attacks in melee, each hit roll of 6+ scores 1 extra hit.

ea2aaf9c85db.name: Terror Strike
ea2aaf9c85db.plain: When one of your HOST RAPTORIAL units destroys an enemy unit: until the end of the turn, enemy units within 6" of any of your HOST RAPTORIAL units have 1 subtracted from their Leadership characteristic.

ea425f7aa41d.name: Prescience
ea425f7aa41d.plain: Blessing: if this power is manifested, pick one of your <LEGION> units within 18" of this PSYKER. Until your next Psychic phase starts, add 1 to the hit roll of every attack made by a model in that unit.

eb7b5e426b45.name: The Great Sorcerer
eb7b5e426b45.plain: At the start of your Psychic phase: pick one of your TRAITORIS ASTARTES TZEENTCH PSYKER units, then pick one of these rules for it: it can attempt to manifest 1 extra psychic power this phase; or this phase it can attempt both 1 psychic action and 1 psychic power.

eb95b96e1d11.name: Taken Alive
eb95b96e1d11.plain: In the Fight phase, when one of your CREATIONS OF BILE models destroys the enemy WARLORD with a melee attack. For the rest of the battle: every model in your opponent's army has 1 subtracted from its Leadership characteristic; your opponent can't use the Insane Bravery Stratagem; and no rules can be used by your opponent to re-roll a Morale test.

ec43089bb58b.name: Spreading Vermin
ec43089bb58b.plain: If your army is Battle-forged, a Detachment can include one MUTOID VERMIN unit for each GELLERPOX INFECTED unit in it, and those MUTOID VERMIN units don't use up a Battlefield Role slot. Your army can't contain more MUTOID VERMIN units than GELLERPOX INFECTED units.

ec502386d6c3.name: Forward, for the Dark Gods
ec502386d6c3.plain: Once per turn, this unit can use this ability when one of your TRAITOR GUARDSMAN SQUAD units fails a Morale test while it is within 6" of this unit's TRAITOR ENFORCER model. If it does, until the end of the phase, that TRAITOR GUARDSMAN SQUAD unit automatically passes any Combat Attrition tests it takes.

ed2bf80cb02f.name: Sound the Black Hunt
ed2bf80cb02f.plain:
In your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when one of your NIGHT LORDS CORE, NIGHT LORDS DAEMONKIN or NIGHT LORDS CHARACTER units is chosen to shoot or fight. For the rest of the phase, whenever a model in that unit attacks:
- Hit rolls of 1 are re-rolled if the target has a Leadership characteristic of 6 or less, or was below its Starting Strength at the moment the attacking unit was chosen to shoot or fight.
- You can re-roll the hit roll if the target has a Leadership characteristic of 5 or less, or was below Half-strength at the moment the attacking unit was chosen to shoot or fight.

eea0e0cc46bd.name: Decimator claws
eea0e0cc46bd.plain: If this model has 2 decimator claws, it gets 1 extra attack with 1 of them whenever it fights.

ef104c19ef22.name: Malevolent Locus (Aura)
ef104c19ef22.plain: Aura: while one of your TRAITORIS ASTARTES units is wholly within range of this ability, its models get a 4+ invulnerable save against ranged attacks. Enemy units within range of this ability have 1 subtracted from the Leadership characteristic of their non-CHAOS models. The range grows each battle round: 6" in round 1, 9" in round 2, 12" in round 3, 15" in round 4, and 18" in round 5+.

efc485fdb7a9.name: Surgeon Acolyte
efc485fdb7a9.plain:
While this unit includes a SURGEON ACOLYTE model:
- Whenever FABIUS BILE finishes the Enhance Warriors action, roll a pair of D3 rather than a single D3 to find the chosen unit's enhancement, then pick either result.
- Ignore a destroyed SURGEON ACOLYTE model when taking Morale tests.
- Should FABIUS BILE be destroyed at any point, the SURGEON ACOLYTE model in this unit is destroyed as well.

f053719676a1.name: Explodes (Venomcrawler)
f053719676a1.plain: If this model is destroyed, roll a D6 before taking it off the battlefield. On a 5+, it explodes and every unit within 6" takes D3 mortal wounds.

f0ee3e38aeae.name: Incessant Disdain
f0ee3e38aeae.plain:
In the Heroic Interventions step of your opponent's Charge phase: pick one of your EMPEROR'S CHILDREN CORE, EMPEROR'S CHILDREN DAEMONKIN or EMPEROR'S CHILDREN CHARACTER units. For the rest of the phase:
- If it is not a CHARACTER unit, it can perform Heroic Interventions as though it were a CHARACTER unit.
- If it is a CHARACTER unit, it can perform a Heroic Intervention if any enemy unit is within 6" horizontally and 5" vertically of it, and when it does, each of its models can move up to 6".
- Whenever one of its models makes a pile-in or consolidation move, it can move up to 3" further.

f1b18821f271.name: Berserker icon
f1b18821f271.plain: The bearer's unit gets the ICON keyword. Whenever this unit makes a Blood Surge move, if it is performing an action, that action is completed (rather than failing) before the move is made.

f3048e92d3f2.name: Confluence of Traitors
f3048e92d3f2.plain: In your Command phase: pick one of your BLACK LEGION HERETIC ASTARTES units, then pick one Legion Trait. Until the start of your next Command phase, that unit's models have that Legion Trait. You can use this Stratagem only once.

f39472ba5937.name: Enhance Warriors (Action)
f39472ba5937.plain: At the end of your Movement phase, FABIUS BILE can begin this action. If he does, pick one of your TRAITORIS ASTARTES CORE units within 3" of him that has neither the MARK OF CHAOS keyword nor an enhancement. The action is completed at the end of your Shooting phase if the chosen unit is still within 3" of FABIUS BILE. If it is completed, roll one D3: the chosen unit gains the matching enhancement from the Enhance Warriors table for the rest of the battle.

f3f7f99fdfed.name: Tank Destroyers
f3f7f99fdfed.plain: In your Shooting phase or the Fight phase: pick one enemy VEHICLE unit. For the rest of the phase, whenever an IRON WARRIORS HERETIC ASTARTES model attacks that unit, an unmodified hit roll of 6 wounds the target automatically.

f4f2e7aeb155.name: Graviton cannon
f4f2e7aeb155.plain: Blast. Against a unit whose Save characteristic is 3+ or better, attacks from this weapon have Damage 3 instead of 2.

f5f9a06a80f7.name: The Warp's Malice
f5f9a06a80f7.plain: This weapon's type becomes Pistol 4 while the bearer is engaged in Wanton Massacre or Wanton Slaughter. When an attack with this weapon gets an unmodified hit roll of 6, it inflicts 2 mortal wounds on the target and ends the attack sequence.

f63a3e44a7c7.name: Vindicator siege shield
f63a3e44a7c7.plain: Add 1 to armour saving throws made against ranged attacks allocated to the bearer.

fa501cf3f3a3.name: Soulforged Pack
fa501cf3f3a3.plain: When you choose your army: pick one Chaos Space Marine Detachment in your army to be a Soulforged Pack Specialist Detachment. The WARPSMITH and DAEMON ENGINE units in it get the SOULFORGED PACK keyword.

faf38d8c350d.name: Pact of Flesh
faf38d8c350d.plain:
Blessing: if this power is manifested, pick one of your <LEGION> CORE, <LEGION> DAEMONKIN or <LEGION> CHARACTER units within 18" of this PSYKER.
- One model in that unit gets back up to D3 lost wounds.
- If you picked a CORE or DAEMONKIN unit that is below its Starting Strength, one of its destroyed models is returned to the unit with all of its wounds.

fb38ba6b48d0.name: Hellforged plasma blaster - Supercharge
fb38ba6b48d0.plain: For every attack with this profile that gets an unmodified hit roll of 1, the bearer suffers 1 mortal wound once it has finished shooting with this weapon.

fb503bc2fa52.name: Trophies of the Long War
fb503bc2fa52.plain: Before the battle, while mustering your army, if your WARLORD has the TRAITORIS ASTARTES keyword: pick one of your TRAITORIS ASTARTES models (not a CHARACTER model) whose profile includes the word 'Aspiring' or 'Champion'. Even though it isn't a CHARACTER model, it can be given one of these Relics of Chaos: Armour of Abhorrence; Ashen Axe; Axe of the Forgemaster; Black Rune of Damnation; Blade of the Relentless; Claw of the Stygian Count; Distortion; Hyper-growth Bolts; Icon of the Hydra Cult; Loyalty's Reward; Maelstrom's Bite; Spitespitter; Talons of the Night Terror; The Armour Diabolus; The Black Mace; The Warp's Malice; Trophies of Slaughter; Viper's Spite. Every Relic in your army must be different. You can use this Stratagem only once, or twice in a Strike Force battle, or 3 times in an Onslaught battle.

fb67fb1fe1b0.name: Wall of Muscle
fb67fb1fe1b0.plain: When an attack is allocated to the TRAITOR OGRYN model in this unit, its Damage characteristic is reduced by 1, but not below 1.

fbabe1c75938.name: Slaughter Blades
fbabe1c75938.plain: If this model has 2 slaughter blades, it gets 1 extra attack with 1 of them whenever it fights.

fbde8a14f30d.name: Refractor Field
fbde8a14f30d.plain: The TRAITOR ENFORCER model in this unit has a 5+ invulnerable save.

fc17fbbaff50.name: Heralds of Doom
fc17fbbaff50.plain: In your Command phase: pick one of your BLACK LEGION LEGIONARIES units on the battlefield. Until the start of your next Command phase, it gains this ability: 'Heralds of Doom (Aura): while an enemy unit that has the Objective Secured ability is within 6" of this unit, that enemy unit loses Objective Secured.'

fc5621c32261.name: Explodes
fc5621c32261.plain: If this model is destroyed, roll a D6 before taking it off the battlefield and before any models embarked in it disembark. On a 6, it explodes and every unit within 6" takes D3 mortal wounds.

fd4b44e6ccee.name: Enhance Warriors
fd4b44e6ccee.plain:
While FABIUS BILE is part of this unit, it can attempt this action:

Enhance Warriors (Action): FABIUS BILE can begin this action at the end of your Movement phase. If he does, pick one of your TRAITORIS ASTARTES CORE INFANTRY units within 3" of him that has neither the MARK OF CHAOS keyword nor an enhancement (see below). The action completes at the end of your Shooting phase, as long as the chosen unit is still within 3" of FABIUS BILE. If it is completed, roll one D3: the chosen unit gains the matching enhancement below for the rest of the battle.

In a Crusade battle, when the battle ends, every enhanced unit that lacks the CREATIONS OF BILE keyword must take an Out of Action test, even ones that were not destroyed.

D3 result and enhancement:
1: Enhanced Musculature. Models in that unit add 1 to their Strength.
2: Enhanced Black Carapace. Models in that unit add 1 to their Toughness.
3: Enhanced Ferocity. Models in that unit add 1 to their Attacks.

fecaa167e9db.name: Chaos Familiar
fecaa167e9db.plain: Once per battle, you can re-roll a single Psychic test for this model.

ff04fa300882.name: Mysterious Protection
ff04fa300882.plain: This model has a 4+ invulnerable save. When an attack targets this model, an unmodified hit roll of 1-3 always fails, whatever abilities the attacking model or its weapon has.

ff69b6c6e046.name: Vox caster
ff69b6c6e046.plain: While one of your TRAITOR ENFORCER units is within 24" of the bearer's unit, the bearer's unit is considered within range of the Forward, for the Dark Gods! ability of that TRAITOR ENFORCER unit.

ff8e9b9de9ae.name: Murderous Perfection
ff8e9b9de9ae.plain: In your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when one of your TRAITORIS ASTARTES SLAANESH units is chosen to shoot or fight. Once in that phase, when resolving an attack by a model in that unit, you can change one hit roll, one wound roll or one damage roll so that its result is a 6. If part of that damage roll is a D3, the 6 is halved to 3 instead.
